description: This PHP source file defines the I18NDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling data access for internationalization features such as fetching language data and translation messages. It interacts with entities like I18NLanguage and I18NLangString, and utilizes Doctrine ORM for database queries.

classes.name: I18NDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for fetching language and translation data from the database within the internationalization module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getLanguageByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NLanguage entity matching the given language code if it is enabled.

methods.name: getAllTranslationMessagesByLangCode
methods.description: Returns an array of translation messages for a specified language code, including group information.

methods.name: createQueryBuilderWrapperForAllTranslationByLangCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for fetching all translation strings and their translations for a given language code, validating the language code in the process.
